svg.title: dnachem-min: application workflow with every source file
svg.desc: Swimlane workflow of dnachem-min. Every source file (headers, sources, sim.cc, tests, CMakeLists.txt) appears as a chip inside the class box it belongs to; numbered dots show the other phases where the file is also used.
svg.text: dnachem-min workflow with every source file
Geant4 owns the control flow; project classes plug in and the kernel calls them back (red dashed). Each chip is a source file placed in the class box it belongs to.
= Class.cc + Class.hh (home phase colours the border)
= header only; dots = other phases using it:
then executes the macro (batch) or opens the GUI
Serial run manager by default, MT if --threads N > 0
G4UImanager parses and dispatches macro commands
G4Random engine (seed becomes part of the manifest)
each project class plugs into a Geant4 base class
(box size, pH, scavengers for the chemistry stage)
G4VChemistryWorld: the interface the chemistry reads
reactions of the selected Chemistry, SBS time step)
Geant4-DNA processes attached to e- in water
chemistry stage stops at this time
Tracking and Stepping actions; TimeStepAction on
G4RunManager / G4EventManager keep the user actions
G4Scheduler: clock of the chemistry stage
Geant4 drives it, project classes hook in through callbacks
first event also records the beam (particle, energy,
Loops over the N events of the run
Creates the Run object (its seed is read here)
the e- slows down in water,
Reads each step's post-step process name;
names containing "G4DNA" are counted in a
Ionisation and excitation create radiolytic species
Discrete interactions show up as post-step processes
NewStage(): stack empty, so chemistry may start
TimeStepAction: counts each reaction firing per
Dissociation gives species, scheduler steps them
Reactions come from the selected Chemistry table
Bulk scavengers and pH buffer act as reactions

ScoreSpecies (primitive scorer in the detector) reads
the molecule counters: species vs time, all events
EventAction forwards begin/end to the chemistry
Counters reset before each event and run
MT: worker results merged into the master Run
data outlives the run; files appear only at a dump
End of run: energy, counters, run record accumulate.
Merge collects worker data into the master Run
RunAction::EndOfRunAction is called by the kernel
Output files (dump prefix or subdir applied)
CMakeLists.txt builds the sim target from every source above; each test compiles only the files it covers (phase of covered file in brackets)

sim (sim.cc + all src/*.cc), ArgParserTest, OutputDirTest, ChemistryRegistryTest, ScavengerSpecTest, ReactionTableDumpTest, PhysicsInteractionCounterTest, ReactionCounterTest, RunAccumulatorTest, ManifestWriterTest
need the Geant4 kernel to run
They are checked by the sim smoke run.
